thread:
sophia_procure: Quick thread — SpendLens renewal auto-renews next Friday. They sent two pricing options (seat-based annual vs usage-based). Need a recommendation from finance + platform. Any red flags?

olivia_fin: Do we have recent usage numbers to model both? want to see 3mo and peak. Also any outstanding invoices with them?

kevin_platform: Sharing quick numbers: last 90d avg ~1.1B tokens/mo, peak ~2.4B. Most traffic is chat gen from product and a background rerank job. Short calc below:

```
Usage model: $0.00045 / token -> 1.1B * $0.00045 = $495,000/mo
Seat model: 10 seats * $4,200 = $42,000/mo (but seats cap per-seat throughput; infra/service calls may require extra seats)
Hybrid offer (what we asked for): base 8 seats + overage at $0.00028/token
```

nate_ops: Seat model worries me — infra/backfill jobs will consume seats unless vendor gives service account exemption. Also require EU data residency + customer-managed KMS. Can vendor commit to that?

ryan_spendlens: Hi all — Ryan from SpendLens. Thanks for the numbers, Kevin. We can do a hybrid renewal: base seats + overage. Proposed commercial: 12-month term, 8 seats @ $4,000/seat + overage $0.00028/token, and 15% discount for multi-year commit. EU data residency and SOC2 are included; KMS can be integrated (additional fee for HSM-backed keys). Happy to send redline.

legal_bot: Heads up — vendor contract has a broad indemnity (section 7.2) and 60-day data export window (section 12.4). Recommend asking for reciprocal indemnity limit and 30-day export SLA plus 48h incident notification.

olivia_fin: Budget note: finance can approve if expected spend stays < $200k/mo. Based on Kevin's calc pure usage is ~ $495k/mo — too high. Hybrid could work if true overage rates and committed discount bring us under $200k. Need committed tiers (thresholds + discounts) and clear monthly CSV usage reports.

ryan_spendlens: We can provide monthly usage CSV, per-route latency histograms, and support a committed-tier schedule. Example committed tiers we can propose: 10% off at 500M tokens/mo, 20% at 1B tokens/mo, 30% at 2B tokens/mo. Open to negotiating exact thresholds.

sophia_procure: Plan: I'll reply with a counter-offer asking for hybrid 12mo with option to convert to pure usage at month 7, capped overage to protect budget, KMS included, and the legal changes (30-day export + 48h notification). Any objections? If no objections I'll send the counter and cc finance. :thumbsup:

olivia_fin: +1 from finance. Please cc finance@redwood.com for PO and invoicing.

kevin_platform: +1 from platform. Recommend adding telemetry quota exemptions for internal infra jobs so we don't blow seat counts.

sophia_procure: Great — I'll draft reply now and tag Ryan. Thanks everyone.
